name: What happens during a paint color consultation?
description: An expert discusses your preferences and evaluates your space's lighting and decor. They then present color swatches and guide you to a final color decision.

mainEntity.name: What happens during a paint color consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a consultation, our color expert will meet with you to discuss your preferences, lifestyle, and the function of each room. They will evaluate your space's natural and artificial lighting, existing finishes, and decor. Based on this assessment, they will present color swatches, discuss potential palettes, and explain why certain colors would work best, guiding you to a final decision.
